title: Autonomous AI systems test governance in physical environments
summary: This article discusses how autonomous AI systems are expanding from digital environments into physical spaces like warehouses, delivery networks, and public areas, creating a governance gap as existing AI regulations primarily address online harms rather than physical-world deployments.
problem_solved: Addresses the regulatory mismatch between current AI governance frameworks designed for digital/online contexts and the emerging need for oversight of AI systems operating in physical environments.
why_valuable: Highlights a critical and timely policy gap as AI systems increasingly interact with the physical world, where failures could cause tangible harm to people and property rather than just information-related issues.
